question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 10.**
solution:
The correct answer is: impatient

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Impatient** means wanting something to happen soon.
 
• **Immobile** means not moving or not being able to move.
 
• Immature means not fully grown or developed.
 
• **Immediate** means occurring or accomplished without delay; instant.
 
 

 
• So, as per the uses of the given words 'impatient' is the most appropriate word.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "**a few joint managers of takeaways and bored waitstaff eager to get home quickly.**"

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *On Hauz Khas Road, at the entrance to the pedestrianised Hauz Khas Village, the guard (1) at __the barrier asks you to halt and directs __(2) you__ to the parking lot. It's 5 p.m. and the parking lot is nearly empty as shops are closed and there are __(3) hardly__ any shoppers. There aren't many people on the lane leading to the __(4) residential__ area either. This is unusual for HKV (as it is popularly known) __(5) because __it is one of Delhi's popular shopping areas. Initially a hub for designer __(6) clothes__, the HKV experience __(7) had become__ a throbbing mix of cafes, art galleries, curio shops, gyms and, of course, fashion boutiques. The quirky neighbourhood was a hit__ ____(8) particularly__ with youngsters and tourists for its happening nightlife. These days however, night comes hours __(9) before__ dusk at HKV as you can only see street dogs, security guards, a few takeaway joint managers and bored attendants **__(10) impatient __**to reach home early.*
